audit.why: Lane difficulty is EVEN (5.5/10) and the level chart matches between full and content layers (Skill/Skill/Skill/Swain/Swain/Swain/Lulu) — Lulu holds early poke, Swain's DoT/root sustain takes over mid, Lulu's utility flips it back late.

Power spikes are already stated: level 2 coin-flip on landed Nevermove, level 6 Demonic Ascension out-sustains poke, first item Blackfire Torch amplifies drain, late Whimsy/Wild Growth cancel his ult engage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Multiple fields label Nevermove as Swain's W ('Nevermove (W)', 'dodging his W setup'), but the kit shows Nevermove is his E — W is Vision of Empire, a long-range global poke/reveal, an entirely different tool.
audit.why: enemyAbilities in the packet and enemyKit both list Nevermove under slot E and Vision of Empire under slot W. Calling the root 'W' misdirects a reader trying to track its actual cooldown (12/11.5/11/10.5/10s) and conflates it with the unrelated long-range poke ability.
audit.corrected: Corrected slot letter to (E) in content.wants.foe[0], content.spikes[0].text, and content.whys[2]; added the real Nevermove (E) cooldown numbers to breakdown.cooldowns.
